name: OCR - Extrair Texto de PDF Imagem

parameters.command:
=pdftoppm -r 200 -png "{{ $json.caminhoPdf }}" /tmp/ocr_page
rm -f /tmp/ocr_all.txt /tmp/ocr_all.tsv
PAGE=0
for f in $(ls /tmp/ocr_page-*.png | sort -V); do
  PAGE=$((PAGE+1))
  tesseract "$f" - -l por 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/ocr_all.txt
  echo "###PAGINA:$PAGE###" >> /tmp/ocr_all.tsv
  tesseract "$f" - -l por tsv 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/ocr_all.tsv
done
rm -f /tmp/ocr_page-*.png
cat /tmp/ocr_all.txt
echo "###TSV_SEPARADOR###"
cat /tmp/ocr_all.tsv
